title: Build Android Apps with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
goal: Become a job-ready junior Android developer, focusing on Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, with a polished project portfolio.

phases.title: Introduction and Setup
phases.goal: Set up the development environment and understand the basics of Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

phases.title: Core Kotlin Concepts
phases.goal: Master essential Kotlin syntax and constructs.

phases.title: Jetpack Compose Basics
phases.goal: Learn the fundamentals of Jetpack Compose for building user interfaces.

phases.title: Intermediate Jetpack Compose
phases.goal: Explore more advanced features of Jetpack Compose and build a small application.

phases.title: Project Development and Polishing
phases.goal: Develop a portfolio project and refine its functionality and user experience.

phases.title: Job Preparation
phases.goal: Prepare for job interviews, optimize the portfolio project, and apply for junior Android developer positions.

tasks.title: Install Android Studio and Kotlin Plugin
steps: Download and install Android Studio from https://developer.android.com/studio
Enable the Kotlin plugin in Android Studio settings.
tasks.doneWhen: Android Studio is installed and Kotlin plugin is enabled.
tasks.check: Verify installation by opening a sample Kotlin project.

tasks.title: Set Up Git and Version Control
tasks.why: Important for managing code changes and collaborating.
steps: Install Git from https://git-scm.com/downloads
Set up a GitHub or GitLab account
Create a new repository and clone it to your local machine
tasks.doneWhen: You have cloned the repository and can push and pull code.
tasks.check: Create a new file in the repository and commit it.

tasks.title: Understand Basic Android Architecture
tasks.why: Key to building Android apps efficiently.
steps: Read the official Android Architecture documentation: https://developer.android.com/topic/libraries/architecture
Watch a video on MVVM architecture in Android: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=482L6z7oL3k
tasks.doneWhen: You understand the basic concepts of MVVM and Android Architecture Components.
tasks.check: Write a brief summary of the key takeaways.

tasks.title: Practice Basic Kotlin Syntax
tasks.why: Master the basics of Kotlin, which is used in Jetpack Compose.
steps: Create a simple Kotlin script with basic syntax, variables, and functions.
Run the script in the terminal and verify the output.
Add basic control structures like if-else and loops to the script.
tasks.doneWhen: You can write and run basic Kotlin scripts.
tasks.check: Run a script with functions, variables, and control structures.

tasks.title: Learn Basic Kotlin Programming
tasks.why: Master Kotlin syntax and programming concepts.
steps: Read the official Kotlin documentation on data types and expressions: https://kotlinlang.org/docs/data-types.html
Read the official documentation on control structures: https://kotlinlang.org/docs/control-flow.html
tasks.doneWhen: You understand Kotlin data types and control flow.
tasks.check: Create a small Kotlin script with data types, expressions, and control structures.

tasks.title: Practice Kotlin Programming
tasks.why: Apply what you learned about Kotlin to real-world problems.
steps: Create a script to calculate the factorial of a number using recursion.
Create a script to reverse a string using loops and string manipulation.
tasks.doneWhen: You can write and run Kotlin scripts that solve real-world problems.
tasks.check: Run scripts for factorial and string reversal.

tasks.title: Learn Jetpack Compose Basics
tasks.why: Understand the basics of Jetpack Compose and its components.
steps: Read the official Jetpack Compose documentation: https://developer.android.com/jetpack/compose
Watch a tutorial on creating your first Jetpack Compose app: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kP78XfXUx0s

resources.t: Creating Your First Jetpack Compose App

tasks.doneWhen: You understand the basic concepts of Jetpack Compose and can create a simple app.
tasks.check: Run a simple Jetpack Compose app in the Android emulator.

tasks.title: Build a Basic Jetpack Compose UI
tasks.why: Gain hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose by building a simple UI.
steps: Create a new Android project in Android Studio using Jetpack Compose.
Build a UI with basic components like Text, Button, and Box.
Run the app on an emulator and test the UI.
tasks.doneWhen: You have a basic Jetpack Compose UI running on the emulator.
tasks.check: Run the app and verify the UI components work as expected.

tasks.title: Add Interactivity to Jetpack Compose UI
tasks.why: Learn to add interactivity to Jetpack Compose UIs.
steps: Add a click event to a Button component.
Use state and side effects to change the UI dynamically.
tasks.doneWhen: You can add interactivity to a Jetpack Compose UI.
tasks.check: Run an app with dynamic UI changes based on user interactions.

tasks.title: Learn Jetpack Compose Layouts
tasks.why: Master the layout system in Jetpack Compose.
steps: Read the official documentation on Jetpack Compose Layouts: https://developer.android.com/jetpack/compose/layouts
Watch a tutorial on using layouts in Jetpack Compose: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=482L6z7oL3k
tasks.doneWhen: You understand the layout system in Jetpack Compose and can use it to design UIs.
tasks.check: Create a UI with multiple layouts and components.

tasks.title: Build a More Complex Jetpack Compose UI
tasks.why: Develop a more complex Jetpack Compose UI for a demo application.
steps: Design a UI with multiple screens and components.
Implement navigation between screens using Jetpack Compose.
Add state management to the UI components.
tasks.doneWhen: You have a complex Jetpack Compose UI running on the emulator.
tasks.check: Run the app and verify the navigation and state management work as expected.

tasks.title: Optimize Jetpack Compose UI Performance
tasks.why: Learn to optimize Jetpack Compose UIs for performance.
steps: Use the Profiler tool in Android Studio to identify performance bottlenecks.
Apply optimizations to improve the performance of the UI.
tasks.doneWhen: You can identify and optimize performance issues in Jetpack Compose UIs.
tasks.check: Run the app with performance optimizations applied and verify the UI works smoothly.

tasks.title: Learn Jetpack Compose Animation
steps: Read the official documentation on Jetpack Compose Animations: https://developer.android.com/jetpack/compose/animation
Watch a tutorial on using animations in Jetpack Compose: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=482L6z7oL3k
tasks.doneWhen: You understand the basics of Jetpack Compose animations and can create animated UIs.
tasks.check: Create a UI with basic animations.

tasks.title: Develop a Portfolio Project
tasks.why: Create a polished portfolio project to showcase skills.
steps: Choose a simple app idea and design the UI.
Implement the UI and functionality in Jetpack Compose.
Add state management and navigation to the app.
Optimize the app for performance and user experience.
tasks.doneWhen: You have a fully functional and polished Jetpack Compose app.
tasks.check: Run the app and verify all features work as intended.

tasks.title: Prepare CV and Portfolio
tasks.why: Create a strong CV and portfolio to impress potential employers.
steps: Write a CV focusing on your Android development and Jetpack Compose skills.
Prepare a portfolio with your Jetpack Compose project.
tasks.doneWhen: Your CV and portfolio are complete and polished.
tasks.check: Review your CV and portfolio for accuracy and completeness.

tasks.title: Practice Live Coding Interview
tasks.why: Prepare for live coding interviews commonly used in junior Android developer positions.
steps: Create a mock live coding session with a friend or mentor.
Practice solving coding problems related to Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
tasks.doneWhen: You can confidently solve live coding problems related to Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
tasks.check: Run and test your solutions in a mock live coding session.

tasks.title: Prepare for System Design Interview
tasks.why: Prepare for system design interviews, which may be part of the hiring process.
steps: Read system design interview questions and prepare answers.
Practice drawing and explaining system designs on paper or a whiteboard.
tasks.doneWhen: You have prepared answers to common system design interview questions.
tasks.check: Review and practice your answers to common system design interview questions.

tasks.title: Prepare for Take-Home Interview
tasks.why: Prepare for take-home coding assignments, which may be part of the hiring process.
steps: Practice solving coding problems related to Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
Read take-home interview tips and best practices.
tasks.doneWhen: You have prepared for take-home coding interviews.
tasks.check: Practice solving coding problems and review take-home interview tips.

tasks.title: Apply for Junior Android Developer Positions
tasks.why: Submit applications and interviews for junior Android developer positions.
steps: Search for junior Android developer job openings.
Apply to relevant positions and prepare for interviews.
tasks.doneWhen: You have submitted applications and prepared for interviews.
tasks.check: Submit applications and prepare for interviews.
